about: The song facts box on Song Credits, on his LIVE dev app in Max: the box and its About, presentation mode and Esc back to the song page, the box menu's Hide and Undo, and Notes from › None. It sets Notes from back to Apple and Last.fm at the end.
pass: songbox-big: the probe shows heads Tags, Listening Stats, About, Links; the About hint 'From the song's wiki on Last.fm'; the present probe shows the title · Queen and full digits; after Esc: present false, card 'Song', boxStill true. songbox-menu-notes: the menu is Open Last.fm, Hide song info; box false with the toast, then true after Undo; with None, heads without About and about null; Notes from back to Apple and Last.fm.
run: node scripts/shots.mjs --list docs/ops/checks/song-box.json --noise 80   (needs `npm run dev:app` running, its window on screen, Max with the Search card in slot d and Settings in slot right; it plays nothing. Never click a search field: a click there once hit a pinned tile and played it)

shots.about: Search › Bohemian Rhapsody (Queen) › Song Credits: the box, its About, presentation mode, and Esc back to the song page.

steps.eval: (async () => { const s = '[data-slot="d"] '; for (let k = 0; k < 4 && document.querySelector(s + '.panel__title').textContent !== 'Search'; k++) { document.querySelector(s + '.panel__back')?.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 700)); } const i = document.querySelector(s + 'input.search__input'); i.value = 'Bohemian Rhapsody'; i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); for (let k = 0; k < 40; k++) { if (document.querySelector(s + '.search__song[data-cid="6781024437"]')) return; await new Promise((ok) => setTimeout(ok, 100)); } throw new Error('no Queen row'); })()

steps.probe: JSON.stringify({ card: document.querySelector('[data-slot="d"] .panel__title')?.textContent, box: { ...document.querySelector('[data-slot="d"] [data-info-box]')?.dataset }, heads: [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-slot="d"] .artist-info__sec .artist-info__h')].map((h) => h.textContent), aboutHint: document.querySelector('[data-slot="d"] .artist-info__about')?.dataset.hint, tags: [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-slot="d"] .artist-info__tag')].map((t) => t.textContent) })

shots.about: The same song page: Hide song info and Undo; Notes from › None empties the About on the next open; back to Apple and Last.fm.

steps.eval: (async () => { const s = '[data-slot="d"] '; for (let k = 0; k < 4 && document.querySelector(s + '.panel__title').textContent !== 'Search'; k++) { document.querySelector(s + '.panel__back')?.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 700)); } const i = document.querySelector(s + 'input.search__input'); i.value = 'Bohemian Rhapsody'; i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); for (let k = 0; k < 40; k++) { if (document.querySelector(s + '.search__song[data-cid="6781024437"]')) return; await new Promise((ok) => setTimeout(ok, 100)); } throw new Error('no Queen row'); })()
(() => { const i = document.querySelector('[data-slot="right"] input'); i.value = 'Notes from'; i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); })()

steps.probe: JSON.stringify({ heads: [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-slot="d"] .artist-info__sec .artist-info__h')].map((h) => h.textContent), about: document.querySelector('[data-slot="d"] .artist-info__about')?.textContent ?? null })

steps.eval: (() => { const i = document.querySelector('[data-slot="right"] input'); i.value = ''; i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); })()
